newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks indicated flat to higher.
newsitem.headline: French stocks indicated flat to higher.

text.p: The French stockmarket was expected to open little changed on Tuesday with the day's main event likely to be U.S. consumer inflation due at 1230 GMT.
U.S. industrial production, capacity utilisation data also due today.
* CAC-40 futures contract traded on GLOBEX up 2 at 2,787
* CAC-40 index fell 0.45 percent on Monday at 2,795.87
* Bond market rose early then fell back on light profit-taking after EU leaders agreed on Monday on a pact to enforce budget discipline after the launch of a single European currency.
In addition to potentially market-moving U.S. economic data, bourse investors likely to be cautious ahead of Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's keynote policy speech on June 19, brokers say.
"The technical configuration suggests a continuation of yesterday's correction ... with an objective of 2,760-2,781," one broker said.
If stocks advance, the resistance level is seen at 2,812, he said.
The CAC-40 index touched an all-time high of 2,825.18 points in early trading on Monday before the market slid back.
